architecture.description: Bible.Systems uses a dynamic D1 sharding architecture to scale beyond D1's 10GB limit per database while maintaining efficient queries.

d1Sharding.overview: Instead of a single D1 database, Bible resources are distributed across multiple shard databases. A catalog database tracks which resource lives in which shard.

catalogDb.name: catalog-chirho
catalogDb.purpose: Master registry that tracks resource locations, shard status, and publisher info

tables.name: resource_locations_chirho
tables.purpose: Maps each resource to its shard

tables.name: publishers_chirho
tables.purpose: Publisher accounts and Stripe Connect info

resourceShards.purpose: Store actual Bible content - verses, words, cross-refs, lexicons

tables.name: word_instances_chirho
tables.purpose: Every word occurrence with morphology, Strong's, Louw-Nida domains

appDb.name: app-chirho
appDb.purpose: Application data - users, feedback, sessions (separate from Bible content)

allocationAlgorithm.description: When adding a new resource (Bible version, commentary, etc.), the system finds the least-full shard and places the resource there.
pseudocode: 1. Query catalog DB for current shard sizes: SELECT shard_index_chirho, SUM(size_estimate_chirho) FROM resource_locations_chirho GROUP BY shard_index_chirho
2. Find shard with minimum total size that won't exceed 8GB after adding new resource
3. If all shards would exceed 8GB, create a new shard (up to configured max)
4. Insert record in resource_locations_chirho mapping resource to chosen shard
5. Return shard binding so caller can insert actual data
allocationAlgorithm.expansionStrategy: Add new shards as needed when all existing shards approach capacity

queryRouting.description: When querying for a resource, the system first looks up its location in the catalog, then queries the appropriate shard.
flow: 1. API receives request for resource (e.g., GET /api-chirho/bible-chirho/kjv/gen/1)
2. Query catalog: SELECT shard_index_chirho FROM resource_locations_chirho WHERE resource_id_chirho = 'kjv'
3. Get D1 binding for that shard: env[`RES_${shardIndex.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')}_CHIRHO`]
4. Query the shard DB for actual data
queryRouting.caching: KV cache sits in front to avoid repeated catalog lookups for popular resources
